title: Mid-game hurt retreat distance: in mid phase with HP < 35%, keep the existing retreat going until the nearest visible enemy is at least ~120 m before stopping to heal (HURT_RETREAT_FAR_ON)
behaviors: in mid phase (zone shrinking to the 2nd/3rd circle, 240 m then 140 m; 5+ alive) with HP < 35% of max, when the champion's existing retreat ('retreat to cover' or 'retreat') was active on the previous decision and we would otherwise start the stand-still heal, keep running that same retreat (same hide-spot / back-away path, same boost rule) until the nearest visible enemy is at least HURT_RETREAT_FAR_M (120 m) away or none is visible; give up after 3 s without progress; never at t < 10 s or with a supply drop announced/landed or a drop run/ring hold possible; drop run, zone and heal rules otherwise unchanged

screens.notes: 0 activations in 96 games (0 at t < 10 s, 0 with a drop called). 15/96 games reach mid phase (zone shrinking to 240/140 m) with 5+ alive; 8 have a champion retreat there; 30 mid-phase retreat ends, all 30 with a supply drop announced or landed (drops are called at 70/140/210 s and stay on the map until captured), so the required drop gate blocks every one. 13 of the 30 (5 games: 41, 44, 73, 84, 89) meet every other P33 condition (heal next, HP < 35%, a visible enemy < 120 m). The p31 logs (main, bases 0 and 2000) agree: in 110-265 s with 5+ alive only 165 of ~26,000 decisions had no drop on the map. Mean score 3.479; deaths < 40 s 33; 0 exceptions.

decision: RETIRED 8:15 PM ET by coordinator: 0/96 activations on old base (a drop is on the map at every mid-phase retreat end); without the gate 5/96, under the floor. Lesson: in the sim an untaken drop sits on the map almost all game, so any 'no drop on the map' gate on a mid-game behavior must be counted before building.
blocker: The required drop gate (no drop announced/landed) blocks every mid-phase retreat in the house sim: drops are called at 70/140/210 s and stay on the map until captured, so mid phase (110-265 s) almost never has zero drops. 30/30 mid-phase retreat ends had a drop live.
next_action: Coordinator decides: retire, or re-brief the drop gate to 'drop run/ring hold possible' only (5/96 games, 13 hand-offs would qualify ignoring the drop gate; at HP < 30% the champion's drop run is already off)
